newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China $13 bln trade surplus in first half.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China $13 bln trade surplus in first half.

text.p: China's trade surplus is expected to reach $13 billion in the first half with exports seen soaring while imports inch up, the Financial News said on Tuesday.

Exports were forecast to reach $77 billion in the first half, up 20 percent compared with the same period a year ago, it said quoting a survey by the Information Department of the State Economic and Trade Commission.
Imports were seen at $64 billion, up by just one percent, year-on-year, it said.
China's trade surplus in the first quarter reached $6.71 billion. It recorded a surplus of $12.24 billion for 1996 on total trade of $289.9 billion.
